_readme: Landing page lab. status: draft (preview only with ?lab=ID:V), live (visitors split), done (winner copied into the page, kept for the record). ONE live test at a time (traffic can't carry two). A is always the current page. copy = keys of COPY on apply pages; html = CSS selector -> new innerHTML; flags = switches the page code reads (LAB.flags). redirect = {from page: to page} for whole page tests. primary = the metric that calls the test. Runbook: ~/rtb-ads/lab/README.md

experiments.name: Old Squarespace page (with apply quiz) vs apply page
experiments.hypothesis: The Squarespace page booked 2.6% of landing page views (May to Aug) vs 1.7% on the apply pages (Oct). It shows the price, a 6 part offer stack, named results and the booking step in section 3. Rebuilt with the apply quiz before the calendar so non bookers are still captured.
experiments.result: Not tested. Josh launched the classic page on every lead source URL on 30 Oct 2026 (Squarespace history: 2.6% vs 1.7% of LPV booked). apply* and reset-chelsea now serve it; old quiz page at apply-quiz*.

experiments.name: Question 1 in the hero
experiments.hypothesis: Only 2.6% of visitors start the form but 88% of starters finish. The leak is the 9,000px jump from the hero button to the quiz. Asking question 1 right in the hero is a smaller first step.

A.note: Control: Explore my options button jumps to the form

B.note: Question 1 as big buttons under the headline

experiments.note: Built for the old quiz page (apply-quiz*). Rework for the classic page before running.

experiments.name: Price on screen one
experiments.hypothesis: No price anywhere and 34% of applicants say just looking. Showing $150 against $89 a week reassures buyers and filters tyre kickers. Judge on bookings per finished application too.

B.note: Price anchor replaces the 15 seconds note

html..hero .ctanote: Normally $89 a week. Your first 21 days: $150, all inclusive. Unlimited classes.

experiments.note: Built for the old quiz page (apply-quiz*). Rework for the classic page before running.

experiments.name: V2 page (Undeniable structure) vs classic page
experiments.hypothesis: Josh's coach's page (Undeniable Scale Workshop) structure: qualifier bar, results first, founder letter inviting scepticism, is / isn't for you, week by week, calendar in page, FAQ after. Both sides calendar first and both carry the same hero video with B roll (1 Nov 2026), so this tests page layout only. Same Meta link: the lab redirects half the visitors to the v2 page.
experiments.result: Ended 10 Nov 2026 without a readable result (LAB_KEY never set, so the report could not run). Josh replaced both sides with the updated pages: see AP06.

experiments.name: Updated classic vs V3: both with the application form before the calendar
experiments.hypothesis: Both AP05 pages go straight to the calendar, so anyone who doesn't book leaves no details. Both new pages carry Josh's fixed headline (21 Day Strength Reset / Zero cardio classes only), his sub line, the 10 trials warning bar, the Meta instant form's 3 questions plus contact details before the calendar straight under the video, and a confirmed items only offer stack. One neutral page each, no men/women split. So this tests layout only: classic (photo hero, old Squarespace order) vs V3 (centred hero, letter, is it for you, FAQ). Watch booked per view AND leads per view.
experiments.note: LIVE 10 Nov 2026 (Josh: 'we are using these from now on'). Every ad link (apply, apply-women, apply-men, reset-chelsea) sends 50/50 to the updated classic or the V3 page. Min 14 days, 250 per side, 95%.
